Universal API Platform
Project Overview :
Universal API Platform is a unified integration layer that enables developers to
interact with multiple CRM systems such as HubSpot, Salesforce, and
Pipedrive through a single standardized API.
Objectives:
Reduce integration complexity
Provide a unified CRM schema
Enable secure OAuth connections
Support real-time synchronization
Offer a centralized dashboard
Tech Stack :

Next.js
TypeScript
TailwindCSS
